'''Tionne Solusar's grandmother''' knew much [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] lore, which she imparted to her granddaughter, the future Jedi [[Tionne Solusar]], before her [[Death/Legends|death]]. She also owned a [[Double viol/Legends|double viol]], which Tionne took when she left home. Tionne's grandmother was executed by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] for spreading the aforementioned lore.<ref name="Journal" />
